integrity: The claim uses the published unique-largest-part theorem only where stated. The tied-maximum case is proved independently by explicit modular edge-colorings. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines weak local deficiency only up to the existing interval-colorability dichotomy and does not determine local deficiency. The finite verifier is a stress test; the universal statement is proved analytically.
title: Weak local deficiency one for all complete multipartite graphs
